  [2] File: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` (line ~1950)
      Problem: When "Change status:" says "not-edited" but "Changes made:" contains actual file change claims (e.g., "- updated foo.sh"), the code trusts the authoritative status and does not flag the contradiction. The prompt contract states they "MUST agree" but there's no enforcement of this cross-check.; A buggy or confused editor could report "Change status: not-edited" while also claiming to have made file changes. This would incorrectly set `has_real_changes="false"`, potentially allowing the PR to auto-merge without the claimed changes being committed.; **HARDENING NOTES**; The contradiction detection only exists in the fallback heuristic path (lines 1996-2008). When the authoritative signal is present, no cross-check validates that it agrees with the Changes made section content. Suggested minimal cross-check:; ```bash; if [ "${change_status}" = "edited" ]; then; has_real_changes="true"; has_real_changes="false"; # Cross-check: warn if Changes made appears to contradict not-edited status; if printf '%s\n' "${changes_section}" | grep -qE "^[[:space:]]*- [a-zA-Z]"; then; echo "::warning::Editor claimed Change status: not-edited but Changes made section contains content"; **HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2**; **Summary**: The implementation is correct and addresses the false-positive issue. The contradiction detection gap is a minor hardening concern that could help catch editor bugs.
      Confidence: avg 4.0
      Flagged by: moonshotai_kimi-k2_5

  [3] File: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (line ~1950)
      Problem: if [ "${change_status}" = "edited" ] || [ "${change_status}" = "not-edited" ]; then; if [ "${change_status}" = "edited" ]; then; has_real_changes="true"; elif [ -n "${changes_section}" ]; then; # heuristic that detects contradictions when first line is "- none" ...; When `change_status` is `not-edited`, the code never executes the `elif` branch, so any edit claims present in the `Changes made:` section (contradicting the status) are silently ignored. This violates the stated contract “Change status … MUST agree with ‘Changes made:’” and can mask editor bugs or cause false negatives where the editor claims changes but sets status to `not-edited` and then fails to commit.; An editor output like `Change status: not-edited` together with a `Changes made:` list containing actual file edits will not trigger `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST` even if no commit is produced. This could allow a PR to merge without the claimed fixes or let an editor malfunction go undetected.; Suggested fix: Only treat `edited` as immediately authoritative; for any other status (including `not-edited`), fall back to the heuristic on `changes_section` to detect real change claims. Replace the `if/elif` block starting at line 1950 with:; if [ "${change_status}" = "edited" ]; then; has_real_changes="true"; if [ "${change_status}" != "edited" ] && [ -n "${changes_section}" ]; then; # existing heuristic code (moves the current elif branch body here); This preserves the false-positive fix (sub-bullets are filtered by the heuristic) while restoring contradiction detection for the `not-edited` case.
      Confidence: avg 4.0
